name: researchmesh
description: Academic collaboration & mentorship matching platform — MERN + GraphQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:mongo: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
